verdict.rationale: Puzzle has its own documented REST API, published as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec with a ReadMe reference that includes a balances endpoint, and its MCP surface exposes trial balance, journal entries and ledger accounts. However, full general ledger export in CSV/Excel is documented only as a UI export, and API access is request-gated. missing for 10: explicitly documented REST endpoints for full general ledger and trial balance pulls, documented open-format (CSV/JSON) output via the API, self-serve API access, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats

citations.quote: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0)
tools covering trial balance, cash activity, transactions, journal entries, chart of accounts, invoices, bills, vendors, customers, payroll, revenue/expense/spending metrics and ledger accounts
you can export a full general ledger and financial statements on either cash or accrual basis in excel, csv, and pdf formats.
Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
